messages:
zoe_cs: FYI — customer in HK reports translations suddenly returning Mainland Mandarin instead of Hong Kong Cantonese after last night's canary. They say it worked before rollout. req_id req_0a1b2c attached.

tonysupport (customer pasted):
> Headers: Accept-Language: zh-HK
> Prompt: '請把下面英文翻譯成香港廣東話：
> "We will meet at the harbor at 7pm. Bring the blue folder."'
> Output (what they got): '我們會在晚上7點在港口見面。帶上藍色文件夾。' (zh-CN style / simplified)

zoe_cs: Can reproduce a simplified/mandarin-leaning output in our repro harness when forcing locale=zh-HK. See quick curl they ran.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/translate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Accept-Language: zh-HK" \n  -d '{"source":"en","target":"zh-HK","text":"We will meet at the harbor at 7pm. Bring the blue folder."}'
```

elaine_eng: Noted. Canary was promoted 2026-02-28T17:12Z (model: translate-v2@2026-02-28, change: tokenization + locale fallback tweak). Canary rollout set locale_fallback_priority=[zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh-HK_alias]. Might explain CN bias.

sam_oncall: I pulled the canary trace for req_0a1b2c — model served on ap-east-1 node gpu-12, kernel=quant-int8, route=translate.v2.canary. kv-cache key shows locale="zh-HK" but downstream normalizer maps zh-HK -> zh-Hant then to zh-Hans due to fallback ordering.

lucas_research: Might be a regression in the locale normalization comparator. We recently changed similarity threshold from 0.7 -> 0.55 to improve fallback recall. That could make zh-HK match zh-CN patterns more often, leading to Mainland-style phrasing.

zoe_cs: Customer impact: multiple HK customers reported over past 3 hrs. Samples attached show consistent simplification and Mainland lexicon (e.g., '港口' vs '碼頭' preference). They consider this a P1 for correctness on localization-sensitive apps.

elaine_eng: Agreed escalate. Options: 1) revert locale_fallback_priority change in config (fast) 2) force exact-match mapping for zh-HK in the canonicalizer (requires small patch) 3) rollback canary entirely. Thoughts?

sam_oncall: Quick mitigation: add temporary route override for ap-east-1 -> model translate-v1 (previous stable) for customers with header Accept-Language: zh-HK. Can push via config in ~10m.

deploy-bot: deploy request received: patch=hotfix/locale-exact-match, pipeline=canary -> staging (ETA 8m).

elaine_eng: If deploy-bot succeeds, run A/B checks against our zh-HK prompt set and monitor token-level language markers and BLEU/chrF vs gold. Also watch for latency change.

zoe_cs: I'll inform affected customers and offer to switch them to the stable endpoint until fix is live. Sending repro harness and sample outputs to engineering channel for triage. :thanks: :eyes:

tony_support: Customer asked for expected timeline. I'll tell them ~30-45m to mitigation, 2-4 hrs for full fix + validation.

lucas_research: Post-mortem action: add locale-specific unit tests (zh-HK/zh-TW/zh-CN) and include them in canary gates. Also revert the similarity threshold change until we validate with these tests.

sam_oncall: Update: pushed route override to map Accept-Language: zh-HK -> stable translate-v1 for affected orgs. Verified two sample requests now return Cantonese-leaning outputs (requests from customer test ids). Monitoring metrics.

zoe_cs: Customer confirmed improved outputs. Marking customer thread as acknowledged, will follow up for full postmortem.

elaine_eng: Thanks team — I'll open PR for canonicalizer exact-match and add regression tests. Will link PR here when ready.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to override route at 1890003934.

sam_oncall: last check: no new HK complaints in last 45m, closing incident once postmortem is drafted.
